services.desc: Explore the many forms of abstract art on view at Sheldon Museum of Art with a Sheldon educator. Through guided looking and conversation, discover how artists express ideas beyond representation. Tours at Sheldon are free, but space is limited. Advanced registration is encouraged. Through our collections, exhibitions, and programs, Sheldon Museum of Art inspires inquiry and discovery, serving the University of Nebraska, the state, and beyond. Sheldon is located at 451 North 12th Street in Lincoln, NE. Google Map - Directions & Parking information Thank you for your interest in the Sheldon Museum of Art.
